passive.name: Death in Lavender
passive.desc: Bel'Veth gains permanent attack speed stacks after taking down large minions and monsters and champions. She also gains temporary bonus attack speed after using an ability.

spells.name: Void Surge
spells.desc: Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through.

spells.name: Above and Below
spells.desc: Bel'Veth slams her tail to the ground, damaging, knocking up, and slowing her enemies.

spells.name: Royal Maelstrom
spells.desc: Bel'Veth roots herself in place, channeling a storm of slashes around her that targets the lowest-health enemy and grants her lifesteal and damage reduction.

spells.name: Endless Banquet
spells.desc: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, and attack speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her the power to summon Void remora.
